statements.subject: timer
statements.description: If timer C should fire, the proxy MUST either reset the timer with any value it chooses, or terminate the client transaction.
actions: reset Timer C with chosen value

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If timer C should fire and the client transaction has received a provisional response, the proxy MUST generate a CANCEL request matching that transaction.
statements.post_cond: CANCEL request generated matching client transaction
actions: generate CANCEL request matching client transaction

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If timer C should fire and the client transaction has not received a provisional response, the proxy MUST behave as if the transaction received a 408 (Request Timeout) response.
actions: treat transaction as if 408 Request Timeout response received
